readerCopy.body: A sudden break from expectation can bring a preference or refusal into the open before anyone has a plan for what comes next. When Uranus conjoins Lilith, disruption and autonomy move together, making an unconventional choice, abrupt exit, changed rule, or long-suppressed no harder to keep contained. There may be much less patience for preserving an arrangement simply because it is familiar. The break can create freedom and extra problems at the same time. The useful change is the one that removes the restriction that stopped fitting without destroying every support around it.
